map.批量统计出勤率、应扣款、加班费与全勤奖: Batch attendance rate, deductions, overtime pay and full-attendance bonus
map.出勤率 = 实际出勤天数 ÷ 应出勤天数 × 100%，实际出勤 = max(应: Attendance rate = days attended ÷ required days × 100%; days attended = max(required − absences − leave, 0) (clamped at 0, overtime excluded). Deduction = late count × late rate + early-leave count × early rate + absence days × absence rate. Overtime pay = overtime hours × hourly rate. Full-attendance bonus is paid only with no late arrival, early leave, absence or leave. Validation: required days default to 1, rates and fines default to 0, negatives treated as 0. Grading: ≥95 excellent, ≥85 good, ≥75 pass, otherwise abnormal; totals cover late/early/absence/leave/overtime/deductions/bonus/overtime pay.

map.出勤率 = 实际出勤天数 ÷ 应出勤天数 × 100%；扣款 = 迟到×迟到单价: Attendance rate = days attended ÷ required days × 100%; deduction = late × late rate + early × early rate + absence × absence rate; overtime pay = overtime hours × hourly rate; the full-attendance bonus goes only to staff with no late arrival, early leave, absence or leave. Everything is computed locally and never uploaded.

map.本工具按「加班小时 × 加班单价」估算加班费，延时/休息日倍率差异需在单价中体现: This tool estimates overtime pay as overtime hours × hourly rate; put the multiplier differences for weekdays and rest days into the rate, and convert comp time separately per company rules.
map.默认「无迟到、无早退、无旷工、无请假」才发放；若公司允许 N 次迟到，请把迟到扣: By default it requires no late arrival, early leave, absence or leave; if the company tolerates N late arrivals, set the late deduction to 0 or adjust manually — the tool has no built-in tolerance count.
